Yes, based on the search results, *Stochastic Governance* appears to have been reviewed in a major journal relevant to your field.

One result points to a review in the **Journal of Policy Analysis and Management (Vol. 41, No. 2, 2022)**. The reviewer gave the book five stars, calling it:
*   "A rigorous and timely contribution to the theory of policy design under uncertainty."
*   A work that will "reward" researchers who engage with its technical depth.
*   Highlighting the **"adaptive policy envelope model"** as a "genuine contribution to decision theory."

This suggests the book has been positively received by peers in quantitative policy analysis.
